settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals appear in the customer's credit history. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is recorded for account support.

settings.title: Shipping and Digital Delivery Policy
settings.body:
No physical shipping

MyDreamShoots sells digital AI photo credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, support may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy.

No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by MyDreamShoots.

Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com with the account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.title: Aidreamcapes FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answers about source photos, travel package choice, credits, privacy, delivery, and refunds.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clear source photos.|Pick a travel direction.|Spend visible credits.|Review the private gallery.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

Aidreamcapes collects the information needed to operate a private AI portrait workspace: account email, authentication state, source photos, reference notes, package selections, prompts, generation settings, credit ledger events, checkout status, support messages, generated outputs, downloads, and basic device or request metadata used for security and reliability.

2. How we use information

We use this information to create requested travel portraits, reserve and settle credits, deliver private galleries, keep account history accurate, provide support, prevent misuse, troubleshoot failed jobs, improve source-photo guidance, and show the right workspace pages after sign-in.

3. Source photos and generated images

Uploads and generated results stay tied to the current Aidreamcapes site and signed-in customer account. They are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. Infrastructure and AI providers may process files only as needed to complete the service requested by the customer.

4. Payments, credits, and retention

Payments are handled by a connected payment provider. Aidreamcapes stores order IDs, checkout status, subscription state, credit purchases, reservations, reversals, and refund records; it does not store full card numbers on its own servers. Account records and generated assets are retained while needed for delivery, support, compliance, security, and customer access.

5. Customer choices and contact

Customers can contact support to ask about access, deletion, correction, privacy review, or account-specific delivery questions. Email support@aidreamcapes.com and include the account email plus any relevant order, job, or gallery details so the request can be reviewed safely.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
1. Refund eligibility

Refund requests are reviewed based on credit use, checkout status, subscription state, and whether generation work has already been completed. Unused one-time credit purchases may be eligible for review within the stated support window, while credits already consumed by successful travel generations are generally not refundable.

2. Failed or interrupted jobs

If a service-side technical failure prevents generation or private gallery delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the request, provide troubleshooting, or review a refund. Support may ask for the account email, package name, job status, approximate request time, and any error message shown in the workspace.

3. Subscriptions and renewals

Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund credits already granted or spent. Subscription refunds depend on payment status, usage, local requirements, and whether credits from the billing period have been applied to completed generations.

4. Non-refundable cases

Refunds are usually not available for dissatisfaction caused by unclear source photos, unsupported requests, changed creative preferences after generation, or outputs that were delivered according to the selected package. Customers should review source-photo guidance before starting a package run.

5. How to request review

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, checkout reference if available, package or job details, and a short explanation. Support will review the ledger and delivery records before deciding whether to release credits, rerun work, or refund eligible payments.

settings.body:

Upload only portraits, product references, wardrobe notes, location inspiration, or creative direction that you own, created, licensed, or have permission to use. AI results may contain artifacts, inaccurate details, unexpected styling, or visual assumptions. Customers should review final images before using them publicly, commercially, or in identity-sensitive contexts. Generated results should not be presented as factual documentary evidence of events that did not happen.

settings.title: How to plan source photos for cinematic AI travel portraits
settings.body:
Strong Aidreamcapes results start before generation. Choose recent portraits with clear facial detail, natural expressions, and enough variation in angle, lighting, and distance for the private workflow to understand the subject.

Pick photos that preserve identity

Use simple, sharp images first. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group shots when the request needs consistent travel portraits.

Add destination references without overloading the request

A coastal light set might need warm light and relaxed wardrobe notes. An old quarter walk can use cafe, plaza, and boutique hotel references. A alpine trail frame set benefits from outdoor layers, scenic overlook notes, and preferred season.

Match the package to the final use

Choose Route Portrait Albums for broad atmosphere, Coastal Light Sets for warm sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for outdoor scenes, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

Review privately before sharing

settings.title: How to plan source photos for cinematic AI travel portraits
settings.body:
Strong Aidreamcapes results start before generation. Choose recent portraits with clear facial detail, natural expressions, and enough variation in angle, lighting, and distance for the private workflow to understand the subject.

Pick photos that preserve identity

Use simple, sharp images first. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group shots when the request needs consistent travel portraits.

Add destination references without overloading the request

A coastal light set might need warm light and relaxed wardrobe notes. An old quarter walk can use cafe, plaza, and boutique hotel references. A alpine trail frame set benefits from outdoor layers, scenic overlook notes, and preferred season.

Match the package to the final use

Choose Route Portrait Albums for broad atmosphere, Coastal Light Sets for warm sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for outdoor scenes, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

Review privately before sharing

settings.subtitle: Answers about source photos, travel package choice, credits, privacy, delivery, and refunds.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clear source photos.|Pick a travel direction.|Spend visible credits.|Review the private gallery.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals appear in the customer's credit history. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is recorded for account support.

settings.title: Shipping and Digital Delivery Policy
settings.body:
No physical shipping

MyDreamShoots sells digital AI photo credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, support may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy.

No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by MyDreamShoots.

Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com with the account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals appear in the customer's credit history. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is recorded for account support.

settings.title: Shipping and Digital Delivery Policy
settings.body:
No physical shipping

MyDreamShoots sells digital AI photo credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, support may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy.

No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by MyDreamShoots.

Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com with the account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

Aidreamcapes collects the information needed to operate a private AI portrait workspace: account email, authentication state, source photos, reference notes, package selections, prompts, generation settings, credit ledger events, checkout status, support messages, generated outputs, downloads, and basic device or request metadata used for security and reliability.

2. How we use information

We use this information to create requested travel portraits, reserve and settle credits, deliver private galleries, keep account history accurate, provide support, prevent misuse, troubleshoot failed jobs, improve source-photo guidance, and show the right workspace pages after sign-in.

3. Source photos and generated images

Uploads and generated results stay tied to the current Aidreamcapes site and signed-in customer account. They are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. Infrastructure and AI providers may process files only as needed to complete the service requested by the customer.

4. Payments, credits, and retention

Payments are handled by a connected payment provider. Aidreamcapes stores order IDs, checkout status, subscription state, credit purchases, reservations, reversals, and refund records; it does not store full card numbers on its own servers. Account records and generated assets are retained while needed for delivery, support, compliance, security, and customer access.

5. Customer choices and contact

Customers can contact support to ask about access, deletion, correction, privacy review, or account-specific delivery questions. Email support@aidreamcapes.com and include the account email plus any relevant order, job, or gallery details so the request can be reviewed safely.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
1. Refund eligibility

Refund requests are reviewed based on credit use, checkout status, subscription state, and whether generation work has already been completed. Unused one-time credit purchases may be eligible for review within the stated support window, while credits already consumed by successful travel generations are generally not refundable.

2. Failed or interrupted jobs

If a service-side technical failure prevents generation or private gallery delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the request, provide troubleshooting, or review a refund. Support may ask for the account email, package name, job status, approximate request time, and any error message shown in the workspace.

3. Subscriptions and renewals

Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund credits already granted or spent. Subscription refunds depend on payment status, usage, local requirements, and whether credits from the billing period have been applied to completed generations.

4. Non-refundable cases

Refunds are usually not available for dissatisfaction caused by unclear source photos, unsupported requests, changed creative preferences after generation, or outputs that were delivered according to the selected package. Customers should review source-photo guidance before starting a package run.

5. How to request review

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, checkout reference if available, package or job details, and a short explanation. Support will review the ledger and delivery records before deciding whether to release credits, rerun work, or refund eligible payments.

settings.title: Digital delivery
settings.body:
1. No physical shipping

Aidreamcapes sells digital AI travel portrait credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

2. Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

3. Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy. Support may ask for the account email, package name, order details, and job status.

4. No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by Aidreamcapes.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Studio Terms
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, creating an account, purchasing credits, uploading source photos, starting a generation job, or opening a private gallery, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy that governs account data, uploads, payment status, and delivery records.

2. Accounts and security

Customers must provide accurate account information, keep sign-in credentials secure, and use the service only for lawful personal, creator, or business workflows. Each account is scoped to its site customer record and should not be shared in a way that bypasses billing, moderation, or privacy controls.

3. Credits, packages, and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, displayed before package creation, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out. Delivery times, output counts, and creative results can vary based on source-photo quality, package settings, provider availability, and safety review.

4. Uploaded content and rights

You may only upload portraits, travel references, wardrobe notes, or route direction that you own or have permission to use. You remain responsible for the source material you submit and for how you use generated outputs. Aidreamcapes may reject, remove, or restrict requests that violate law, policy, platform safety rules, or third-party rights.

5. Service limits and changes

Aidreamcapes may update packages, pricing, credit rules, workflows, providers, delivery limits, or safety practices to keep the service reliable. We may pause or limit access when needed for security, abuse prevention, maintenance, payment issues, or policy enforcement.

6. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, privacy, refund, policy, generation, or private gallery questions. Include the account email and relevant job or order details when requesting support.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Allowed uploads

Upload only portraits, product references, wardrobe notes, location inspiration, or creative direction that you own, created, licensed, or have permission to use. Source photos should be clear enough to support identity-safe travel escape portraits and should not include people who have not consented to the intended use.

2. Disallowed requests

Do not use Aidreamcapes for impersonation, harassment, explicit exploitation, non-consensual imagery, illegal activity, stolen images, hateful or abusive content, deceptive identity use, attempts to bypass moderation, or requests involving protected marks or people in a misleading way.

3. Generated outputs

AI results may contain artifacts, inaccurate details, unexpected styling, or visual assumptions. Customers should review final images before using them publicly, commercially, or in identity-sensitive contexts. Generated results should not be presented as factual documentary evidence of events that did not happen.

4. Review and enforcement

Aidreamcapes may block prompts, reject uploads, pause jobs, remove outputs, release credits, or restrict accounts when content appears unsafe, unauthorized, abusive, unlawful, or outside supported package intent. Support may request more context when a request is ambiguous.

5. Reporting concerns

Email support@aidreamcapes.com to report content concerns, suspected misuse, account access issues, or generated output that needs review. Include the account email, job details, and a concise description of the concern.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. Essential cookies and local storage

Aidreamcapes uses essential cookies and local storage to support sign-in, session security, checkout continuity, cart state, credit visibility, account preferences, private workspace routing, and customer-only gallery access. Some features may not work correctly if this storage is blocked or cleared.

2. Security and reliability signals

We may use limited operational signals such as request metadata, error state, device or browser type, and performance timing to detect failed requests, protect accounts, diagnose delivery issues, and improve site reliability. These signals are used to operate the service rather than to sell personal photos.

3. Payment and third-party tools

Checkout, email delivery, analytics, infrastructure, or AI processing providers may set or read cookies and related identifiers when they are necessary for payment status, fraud prevention, service delivery, security, or operational measurement. Their use is limited by the role they perform for the Aidreamcapes workflow.

4. Your choices

You can clear cookies or adjust browser settings at any time. Clearing storage may sign you out, interrupt checkout, remove local preferences, or require you to sign in again before accessing private albums, jobs, credit history, or downloads.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you have questions about cookies, account sessions, checkout continuity, or private gallery access on Aidreamcapes.

settings.title: How to plan source photos for cinematic AI travel portraits
settings.body:
Strong Aidreamcapes results start before generation. Choose recent portraits with clear facial detail, natural expressions, and enough variation in angle, lighting, and distance for the private workflow to understand the subject.

Pick photos that preserve identity

Use simple, sharp images first. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group shots when the request needs consistent travel portraits.

Add destination references without overloading the request

A coastal light set might need warm light and relaxed wardrobe notes. An old quarter walk can use cafe, plaza, and boutique hotel references. A alpine trail frame set benefits from outdoor layers, scenic overlook notes, and preferred season.

Match the package to the final use

Choose Route Portrait Albums for broad atmosphere, Coastal Light Sets for warm sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for outdoor scenes, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

Review privately before sharing

Finished images return to the Aidreamcapes account gallery, where customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what belongs on profiles, travel posts, gifts, or private keepsakes.

settings.title: Aidreamcapes FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answers about source photos, travel package choice, credits, privacy, delivery, and refunds.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clear source photos.|Pick a travel direction.|Spend visible credits.|Review the private gallery.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

Aidreamcapes collects the information needed to operate a private AI portrait workspace: account email, authentication state, source photos, reference notes, package selections, prompts, generation settings, credit ledger events, checkout status, support messages, generated outputs, downloads, and basic device or request metadata used for security and reliability.

2. How we use information

We use this information to create requested travel portraits, reserve and settle credits, deliver private galleries, keep account history accurate, provide support, prevent misuse, troubleshoot failed jobs, improve source-photo guidance, and show the right workspace pages after sign-in.

3. Source photos and generated images

Uploads and generated results stay tied to the current Aidreamcapes site and signed-in customer account. They are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. Infrastructure and AI providers may process files only as needed to complete the service requested by the customer.

4. Payments, credits, and retention

Payments are handled by a connected payment provider. Aidreamcapes stores order IDs, checkout status, subscription state, credit purchases, reservations, reversals, and refund records; it does not store full card numbers on its own servers. Account records and generated assets are retained while needed for delivery, support, compliance, security, and customer access.

5. Customer choices and contact

Customers can contact support to ask about access, deletion, correction, privacy review, or account-specific delivery questions. Email support@aidreamcapes.com and include the account email plus any relevant order, job, or gallery details so the request can be reviewed safely.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
1. Refund eligibility

Refund requests are reviewed based on credit use, checkout status, subscription state, and whether generation work has already been completed. Unused one-time credit purchases may be eligible for review within the stated support window, while credits already consumed by successful travel generations are generally not refundable.

2. Failed or interrupted jobs

If a service-side technical failure prevents generation or private gallery delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the request, provide troubleshooting, or review a refund. Support may ask for the account email, package name, job status, approximate request time, and any error message shown in the workspace.

3. Subscriptions and renewals

Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund credits already granted or spent. Subscription refunds depend on payment status, usage, local requirements, and whether credits from the billing period have been applied to completed generations.

4. Non-refundable cases

Refunds are usually not available for dissatisfaction caused by unclear source photos, unsupported requests, changed creative preferences after generation, or outputs that were delivered according to the selected package. Customers should review source-photo guidance before starting a package run.

5. How to request review

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, checkout reference if available, package or job details, and a short explanation. Support will review the ledger and delivery records before deciding whether to release credits, rerun work, or refund eligible payments.

settings.title: Digital delivery
settings.body:
1. No physical shipping

Aidreamcapes sells digital AI travel portrait credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

2. Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

3. Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy. Support may ask for the account email, package name, order details, and job status.

4. No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by Aidreamcapes.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Studio Terms
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, creating an account, purchasing credits, uploading source photos, starting a generation job, or opening a private gallery, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy that governs account data, uploads, payment status, and delivery records.

2. Accounts and security

Customers must provide accurate account information, keep sign-in credentials secure, and use the service only for lawful personal, creator, or business workflows. Each account is scoped to its site customer record and should not be shared in a way that bypasses billing, moderation, or privacy controls.

3. Credits, packages, and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, displayed before package creation, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out. Delivery times, output counts, and creative results can vary based on source-photo quality, package settings, provider availability, and safety review.

4. Uploaded content and rights

You may only upload portraits, travel references, wardrobe notes, or route direction that you own or have permission to use. You remain responsible for the source material you submit and for how you use generated outputs. Aidreamcapes may reject, remove, or restrict requests that violate law, policy, platform safety rules, or third-party rights.

5. Service limits and changes

Aidreamcapes may update packages, pricing, credit rules, workflows, providers, delivery limits, or safety practices to keep the service reliable. We may pause or limit access when needed for security, abuse prevention, maintenance, payment issues, or policy enforcement.

6. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, privacy, refund, policy, generation, or private gallery questions. Include the account email and relevant job or order details when requesting support.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Allowed uploads

Upload only portraits, product references, wardrobe notes, location inspiration, or creative direction that you own, created, licensed, or have permission to use. Source photos should be clear enough to support identity-safe travel escape portraits and should not include people who have not consented to the intended use.

2. Disallowed requests

Do not use Aidreamcapes for impersonation, harassment, explicit exploitation, non-consensual imagery, illegal activity, stolen images, hateful or abusive content, deceptive identity use, attempts to bypass moderation, or requests involving protected marks or people in a misleading way.

3. Generated outputs

AI results may contain artifacts, inaccurate details, unexpected styling, or visual assumptions. Customers should review final images before using them publicly, commercially, or in identity-sensitive contexts. Generated results should not be presented as factual documentary evidence of events that did not happen.

4. Review and enforcement

Aidreamcapes may block prompts, reject uploads, pause jobs, remove outputs, release credits, or restrict accounts when content appears unsafe, unauthorized, abusive, unlawful, or outside supported package intent. Support may request more context when a request is ambiguous.

5. Reporting concerns

Email support@aidreamcapes.com to report content concerns, suspected misuse, account access issues, or generated output that needs review. Include the account email, job details, and a concise description of the concern.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. Essential cookies and local storage

Aidreamcapes uses essential cookies and local storage to support sign-in, session security, checkout continuity, cart state, credit visibility, account preferences, private workspace routing, and customer-only gallery access. Some features may not work correctly if this storage is blocked or cleared.

2. Security and reliability signals

We may use limited operational signals such as request metadata, error state, device or browser type, and performance timing to detect failed requests, protect accounts, diagnose delivery issues, and improve site reliability. These signals are used to operate the service rather than to sell personal photos.

3. Payment and third-party tools

Checkout, email delivery, analytics, infrastructure, or AI processing providers may set or read cookies and related identifiers when they are necessary for payment status, fraud prevention, service delivery, security, or operational measurement. Their use is limited by the role they perform for the Aidreamcapes workflow.

4. Your choices

You can clear cookies or adjust browser settings at any time. Clearing storage may sign you out, interrupt checkout, remove local preferences, or require you to sign in again before accessing private albums, jobs, credit history, or downloads.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you have questions about cookies, account sessions, checkout continuity, or private gallery access on Aidreamcapes.

settings.title: How to plan source photos for cinematic AI travel portraits
settings.body:
Strong Aidreamcapes results start before generation. Choose recent portraits with clear facial detail, natural expressions, and enough variation in angle, lighting, and distance for the private workflow to understand the subject.

Pick photos that preserve identity

Use simple, sharp images first. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group shots when the request needs consistent travel portraits.

Add destination references without overloading the request

A coastal light set might need warm light and relaxed wardrobe notes. An old quarter walk can use cafe, plaza, and boutique hotel references. A alpine trail frame set benefits from outdoor layers, scenic overlook notes, and preferred season.

Match the package to the final use

Choose Route Portrait Albums for broad atmosphere, Coastal Light Sets for warm sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for outdoor scenes, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

Review privately before sharing

Finished images return to the Aidreamcapes account gallery, where customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what belongs on profiles, travel posts, gifts, or private keepsakes.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how MyDreamShoots handles information when customers visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create an account, upload source photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo packages, open private albums, contact support, or use connected checkout and generation tools.

2. Information we collect

We collect account information such as your email address, authentication method, session records, customer profile details, support messages, and communication preferences. We also process uploaded source photos, reference images, package selections, prompts or style choices you submit, generated previews, delivered images, albums, order records, subscription status, credit ledger events, checkout references, device signals, browser type, approximate request metadata, and security logs.

3. How we use information

MyDreamShoots uses this information to operate customer accounts, generate requested AI photo results, reserve and settle credits, deliver private albums, process checkout, detect failed jobs, provide customer support, secure the service, prevent misuse, improve reliability, test new package workflows, and show the correct pages after you sign in.

4. Uploaded photos and generated images

Your uploads and generated results are treated as private customer assets. They are connected to your signed-in account and are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. You decide whether to download, share, or reuse your delivered images. We may temporarily process uploads and outputs with infrastructure or AI providers only to complete the service you requested.

5. Payments, credits, and checkout records

Payments may be processed by Stripe or another connected payment provider. MyDreamShoots stores order IDs, checkout status, plan names, credit purchases, credit reservations, refunds, reversals, and subscription events so your account balance remains accurate. We do not store full card numbers on our own servers.

6. Cookies and similar technology

We use cookies, local storage, and similar tools for sign-in, session security, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, preference memory, rate limiting, diagnostics, and limited analytics. See the Cookie Policy for more detail.

7. Service providers

We may use hosting, database, storage, email, analytics, payment, moderation, and AI infrastructure providers. These providers may process limited customer data only for the purpose of running, securing, generating, storing, or delivering the MyDreamShoots service.

8. Retention and deletion

Uploads, generated results, albums, order records, and credit history may remain available while your account is active so you can revisit past work. You may request deletion of uploaded or generated photos. Some billing, fraud-prevention, tax, security, dispute, and account integrity records may be retained where required or reasonably necessary.

9. Your choices

You may contact us to request access, correction, export, deletion, or help with account privacy. We may need to verify your identity or account ownership before acting on sensitive requests. Browser controls may also let you manage cookies and local storage.

10. Security

We use account-scoped sessions, private customer routes, access checks, security cookies, and operational monitoring to reduce unauthorized access. No online service can guarantee perfect security, so customers should protect their login method and contact us quickly if they suspect unauthorized account use.

11. Children

MyDreamShoots is not intended for children under the age required to consent to online services in their location. Customers should not upload photos of minors unless they have the legal right and consent to do so.

12. Changes and contact

We may update this policy as features, providers, or legal requirements change. Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, deletion, or data-use questions.

settings.question: Can I try MyDreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free. Private model creation and premium photo packages require credits because they use dedicated generation capacity.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploaded photos private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MyDreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Refund eligibility follows the site policy and checkout terms. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable, while failed requests can return reserved credits according to request status.

settings.question: When are credits used?
settings.answer: Credit cost is shown before each generation. Different packages may use different credit amounts based on style, output size, and generation settings.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Studio tools can help prepare inputs, while premium albums use the model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: Access to previous albums follows the account and gallery policy. New package requests may require an active plan or enough available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.
